column1: # Stage S9 K1a, first of five: the API's handler error, JSON wire formats, text policies and request
# parameters become crates/api/api_foundation. The four core folders move whole; the wire formats
# keep only the midnight-UTC date module of the RFC 3339 file, renamed for what it holds (the instant
# modules are fleet_wire_contract's). Each module prefix is one `crate::` row scoped to the API source,
# one `api::` row scoped to the API package (integration tests, binaries) and one `crate::` row
# scoped to the new crate. Grouped use trees were split before the rows ran.
# Folders and the renamed date module
# Inside the new crate, scoped to the folders that become it, first: a file two rows of one prefix
# both reach takes the earlier row
